metadata.description: Complete your order securely at M'Arte.

checkoutSummary.priceChanged: The price has changed since you added this piece to your cart.
checkoutSummary.title: Your order

checkoutSuccess.title: Order Confirmed
checkoutSuccess.description: Thank you for your purchase. If the confirmation email has not reached {email} within a few minutes, contact us and quote the order number below.
checkoutSuccess.pendingDescription: This takes a moment. Your payment went through — we are just recording the order.
checkoutSuccess.unavailableTitle: We could not load this order
checkoutSuccess.unavailableDescription: Your payment may still have gone through. Check your inbox for a confirmation, or contact us and we will look it up.
checkoutSuccess.guestPrompt: Create an account with {email} and this order appears in your history automatically.

salesPaused.title: Orders are paused
salesPaused.description: We have stopped taking orders for a while, so checkout is closed. Your cart will wait here, and you can place your order as soon as we reopen.

checkoutForm.blikRedirect: Enter the 6-digit BLIK code from your banking app.
checkoutForm.p24Redirect: After clicking 'Continue to Review', you will be redirected to Przelewy24 to complete the payment.
checkoutForm.paymentMethodsIntro: Choose how you'd like to pay. All transactions are encrypted and securely processed by Stripe.
checkoutForm.paymentUnavailableHint: Some items in your cart may no longer be available. Please review your cart and try again.
checkoutForm.paymentFormUnavailable: We could not load the payment form
checkoutForm.paymentFormUnavailableHint: Stripe's secure payment form did not load. Check your internet connection and try again.
checkoutForm.paymentExpiredHint: Your items are held for a limited time while you pay, and that time has run out. Start the payment again to hold them once more.
checkoutForm.paymentAwaitingBankHint: Your payment is under way and your bank has not confirmed it yet. If your banking app asks you to approve it, do so there. This page will move on by itself once your bank answers.
checkoutForm.noLockers: No parcel lockers found in this city.

deliverySubsteps.parcelDeliveryTime: We prepare your order within the fulfillment time stated on the product page, counted from the acceptance of the order; with several products, the longest applies. InPost delivery then takes up to 4 business days from dispatch, and we email you the tracking number.
deliverySubsteps.inStoreText: Collect your order at our shop in Bochnia, ul. Wąska 11, between 09:00 and 17:00. It will be ready by the end of the fulfillment time stated on the product page, or the longest of them if you order several products, and we will let you know as soon as it is.
deliverySubsteps.lockerText: Have your package delivered to a secure parcel locker (e.g. InPost Paczkomat).

paymentSubsteps.blik: You will receive a BLIK code request on your banking app after placing the order.
paymentSubsteps.bankTransfer: Transfer details will be provided after placing the order. The order ships once the payment is received.
paymentSubsteps.bankTransferText: After clicking "Complete Order", you will be securely redirected to Przelewy24 to choose your bank and complete the payment.

checkoutForm.saveShippingAddress: Save this shipping address for future use
checkoutForm.saveBillingAddress: Save this billing address for future use
checkoutForm.companyInvoice: I want an invoice for a company
checkoutForm.companyInvoiceHint: We will issue the invoice to this company at the billing address. If the company's address is not the delivery address, untick “Same as shipping address” above and enter it.
checkoutForm.deliveryNotesPlaceholder: e.g. Leave at the front door
checkoutForm.termsAgreement: By placing your order you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number
validation.countryNotDelivered: We currently deliver only within Poland
validation.nipInvalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit Polish tax ID (NIP)

errors.deliveryMethodUnavailable: The delivery method you chose is no longer available. Please choose another one.
errors.lockerRequired: Please choose a parcel locker for this delivery method.
errors.lockerNotFound: InPost does not list the parcel locker you chose. Please choose another one.
errors.insufficientInventory: Some items in your cart are out of stock.
errors.invalidPrice: A product in your cart has an invalid price. Please remove it and try again.
errors.productNotFound: A product in your cart is no longer available.
errors.salesPaused: We have paused orders for a while, so this payment cannot go ahead. Your cart will wait until we reopen.
errors.sessionClosed: This payment can no longer be changed. Please start the payment again.
errors.sessionComplete: This payment has already been completed.
errors.sessionProcessing: Your bank is still confirming this payment, so it cannot be changed now.
errors.tooManyOpenCheckouts: Several payments started for this email address or from your connection have not been paid yet. Finish one of them, or try again in about half an hour, once they have expired.
errors.variantNotFound: A selected option is no longer available.
errors.paymentSessionStale: This payment session is no longer active. We've opened a new one — please choose a payment method and try again.
errors.paymentNotCompleted: Your payment was not completed. Choose a payment method to try again.
errors.blikNewCode: Generate a new BLIK code in your banking app and enter it to try again.
errors.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.paymentFailed: We could not complete the payment. Please try again.
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
validation.postCodeInvalid: Please enter a valid postal code (00-000).

discount.label: Discount code
discount.checkFailed: We could not check that code, so the total is not final yet.

rejection.notFound: We do not recognise that code.
rejection.inactive: That code is no longer active.
rejection.notStarted: That code is not valid yet.
rejection.exhausted: That code has been fully redeemed.
rejection.alreadyUsed: You have already used that code.
